name: Anya's Apartment
description: Anya's minimalist apartment next door. A recently moved-in space that feels somewhat empty and unlived-in, with only the essentials. Clean, organized, and elegant with a touch of loneliness.

spots.name: Bedroom
spots.description: A neat bedroom with minimal decoration. A comfortable bed with clean white sheets takes center stage. The space is organized but feels somewhat empty, reflecting her solitary life. Soft lighting creates an intimate atmosphere.
